tei:div.tei:p: "$ (435)༄༅// lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum bzhugs so//

(436)༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum 'di 'chad pa la gsum/ klad kyi don/ gzhung gi don/ mjug gi don to// dang po la bzhi/ mtshan bstan pa/ mchod par brjod pa/ brtsam par dam bca' ba'i sgo nas lus mdor bstan pa/ mnyan par gdams pa'o// dang po ni/ lam gyi sogs so// gnyis pa ni/ /rje btsun bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ gsum pa ni/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab kun gyi snying po'i don// rgyal sras dam pa rnams kyis bsngags pa'i lam// skal ldan thar 'dod rnams kyi 'jug rgyab byang yin mchan/ ngogs de// ji ltar nus bzhin bdag gis bshad par bya/ bzhi pa ni/ gang dag srid pa'i bde la ma chags shing*// dal 'byor don yod bya phyir brtson pa yis// rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam la yid rton pa'i// skal ldan de dag dad pa'i yid kyis nyon/ /gnyis pa gzhung gi don la gsum/ nges 'byung gi bsam pa/ byang chub kyi sems/ yang dag pa'i lta ba bstan pa'o// dang po la gsum/ nges 'byung bskyed pa'i dgos pa/ ji ltar skyed pa'i babs/ skyes pa'i tshad do// dang po ni/ /rnam dag nges 'byung med par srid mtsho yi// bde 'bras don gnyer zhi ba'i thabs med la// srid la brkam pa yis kyang yus can rnams// kun nas 'ching phyir thog mar nges 'byung btsam/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ tshe 'di'i snang shas ldog pa'i tshul dang*/ phyi ma'i snang shas ldog nas nges par 'byung ba'i tshul la/ dang po ni/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' tshe la long med pa// yid la goms pas tshe 'di'i snang shas log /gnyis pa ni/ /las 'bras mi bslu 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rnams// yang yang bsam na phyi ma'i snang shas ldog /gsum pa ni/ /de ltar goms pas 'khor ba'i phun tshogs la// yid smon skad cig tsam yang mi skye zhing*// nyin mtshan kun tu thar pa don gnyer blo// byung na de tshe nges 'byung skyes pa lags/ gnyis pa byang chub kyi (437) sems bshad pa la gnyis/

theg pa chen por 'jug par 'dod pa dag gis byang chub kyi sems la slob dgos par bstan pa dang*/ byang chub sems la slob tshul dngos bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ /nges 'byung de yang rnam dag sems bskyed kyis// zin pa med na bla med byang chub kyi// phun tshogs bde ba'i rgyu ru mi 'gyur bas// blo ldan rnams kyis byang chub sems mchog bskyed/ gnyis pa ni/ /shugs drag chu bo bzhi yi rgyun gyis khyer// bzlog dka' las kyi 'chi ba dam pos bsdams// bdag 'dzin lhags kyi drwa ba'i sbubs su chud// ma rig mun pa'i smag chen kun nas 'thibs// mu med srid par skye zhing skye ba ru// sdug bsngal gsum gyis rgyun chad med par mnar// gnas skabs 'di 'drar gyur pa'i ma rnams kyi// ngang tshul bsams nas sems mchog bskyed par mdzod/ gsum pa yang dag pa'i lta ba bshad pa la lnga// thar 'dod rnams kyis yang dag pa'i lta ba tshol dgos par gdams pa/ stong pa rten 'brel gyi don du rtogs na rgyal ba dgyes par bstan pa/ snang stong ngo bo so sor 'dzin pa de srid du thub pa'i dgongs pa mi rtogs par bstan pa/ lta ba'i dpyad pa rdzogs pa'i tshad bstan pa/ thal 'gyur ba'i lta ba'i khyad chos bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab mi ldan na// nges 'byung byang chub sems la goms byas kyang*// srid pa'i rtsa ba bcad par mi nus pas// de phyir rten 'brel rtogs pa'i thabs la 'bad/ gnyis pa ni/ gang zhig 'khor 'das chos rnams thams cad kyi// rgyu 'bras nam yang bslu ba med mthong zhing*// dmigs pa'i gtad so gang yin kun zhig pa// de ni sangs rgyas dges pa'i lam la zhugs/ gsum pa ni/ snang ba rten 'brel bslu ba med pa dang*// stong pa khas len bral ba'i go ba gnyis// ji srid so sor snang ba de srid du// da dung thub pa'i dgongs pa rtogs pa med/ bzhi pa ni / nam (438)zhig nges 'jog med par cig car du// rten 'brel mi bslur mthong ba tsam nyid nas// nges shes yul gyi 'dzin stangs kun 'jig na// de tshe lta ba'i dpyad pa rdzogs pa lags/

lnga pa ni/ gzhan yang snang bas yod mtha' sel ba dang*// stong pas med mtha' sel zhing stong pa nyid// rgyu dang 'bras bur 'char ba'i tshul shes na// mthar 'dzin lta bas 'phrog par mi 'gyur ro// gsum pa mjug gi don la gnyis/ thos bsam gyis gtan la phab nas nyams su len par gdams pa'i don bsdu ba dang*/ sbyar byang gis mtha' brgyan pa'o// dang po ni/ de ltar lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum gyi// gnad rnams rang gis ji bzhin rtogs pa'i tshe// dben pa bsten te brtson 'grus stobs bskyed nas// gtan gyi 'dun ma myur du sgrubs shig bu/ gnyis pa ni/ /zhes pa 'di ni mang du thos pa'i dge slong blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyis tsha kho dbon po ngag dbang grags pa la gdams pa'o/ /zhes so// maṅga lam/// /
